name: @mythicalos/react-ui
description: mythicalOS thin React bindings over @mythicalos/ui-core — Button, Input/Toggle/Checkbox, MaskedSecretInput, EmptyState, ConfirmDialog/Scrim, Toast/ToastProvider, Chip, Card, Avatar, StatusLine, SearchInput, Banner, Gauge, and the usePoll/useInterval hooks. Render + framework wiring only — every class string, poll-scheduling math, glyph map, and text composition is derived by @mythicalos/ui-core so this binding and its Preact sibling can never drift. Apache-2.0.
//peerDependencies: PATCH, not minor, despite tightening the @mythicalos/tokens peer floor from ^0.5.17 to ^0.5.19. The floor is honest: .my-term__row--memory's label resolves var(--my-term-memory), minted in tokens 0.5.19; on an older tokens the declaration is invalid and the label falls back to the row's inherited dim body -- cosmetic, never a crash, and exactly the appearance shipping today. Minor was CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: this peer is declared OPTIONAL so no install breaks on it, while the downstream consumer pins this package through an `overrides` block using a caret on a 0.x version -- which pins the MINOR -- so a minor bump would be unreachable there and the fix could not ship at all. Policy for this repo: the published version tracks the COMPONENT surface, and a peer-floor move rides the patch that needs it.

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun test && bun run typecheck
